value.title: Phase 1: Converge the managed block on the mode union

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Add the CommitMode-keyed guidance table, render both guidance surfaces from it, prove the drift is now a compile error rather than a review catch, and refresh this repo's own block.

value.title: TDD the table FIRST. Add `CommitOutcomeGuidance` and the exported `COMMIT_OUTCOME_GUIDANCE: Record<CommitMode, CommitOutcomeGuidance>` to commit-guidance.ts, importing `CommitMode` from commit-service. Each entry declares: the reader-facing outcome label, what harness PROMISES for that mode, and the remedy — which for `ingress-unverified` is explicitly NOT the nudge. Keep it in `src`: typecheck `include` is ["src"], so a contract parked in a test file is compiled nowhere CI looks.
value.receipt: COMMIT_OUTCOMES + COMMIT_OUTCOME_GUIDANCE ('as const satisfies Record<CommitMode, CommitOutcomeGuidance>') in src/services/instructions/commit-guidance.ts; CommitMode imported type-only. TDD: assertions run RED first (6 failed | 24 passed) before the source moved. Round 2 (review F002): the free-text 'remedy' field is gone, replaced by a discriminated CommitRecovery ('drains-this' | 'not-the-remedy' | 'not-applicable') that renderRecovery() turns into prose — the disposition is now load-bearing.

value.title: Render `commitGuidanceBlock()` from the table. Delete the hand-written two-outcome sentence; the outcome list is now generated over the table's entries. Preserve the block's existing voice and the two fence markers byte-exactly — idempotency and stale detection both hang off those markers.
value.receipt: commitGuidanceBlock() renders commitOutcomeLines(); the hand-written two-outcome sentence is deleted. AGENTS_BLOCK_BEGIN/END byte-identical and now pinned by a test against the pre-075 fixture.

value.title: Render the outcome section of `COMMIT_INSTRUCTIONS` from the same table. Leave the surrounding prose alone: why the verb exists, the shapes to avoid, and the Windows not-supported note are all still correct and are not this plan's business.
value.receipt: COMMIT_INSTRUCTIONS renders the same commitOutcomeLines(); the third enumeration in 'What is and is not guaranteed' derived away per ac-0003. Round 3 (review R2-F001): the standalone RECOVERY paragraph is now the derived RECOVERY_SECTION constant — it interpolates NUDGE_VERB, scopes its replay assertion to 'on a POSIX host', and carries NUDGE_PREREQUISITE, so the prerequisite travels with EVERY standalone recovery instruction and the sole-source claim about the verb's name is true rather than aspirational. Surrounding prose still untouched.

value.title: Tests. (a) the block names the unverified outcome and does NOT offer the nudge as its remedy; (b) every table entry's outcome text appears in BOTH surfaces, so a new entry cannot be silently omitted from either; (c) the mode->outcome mapping is pinned, so a future mode cannot be quietly folded into an existing outcome; (d) an AGENTS.md carrying the verbatim pre-075 block reads `stale`, and doctor's row is not-ok with the --inject command in next_action; (e) a refresh inside a file with user content on BOTH sides leaves that content byte-identical, and a second run reports `unchanged`.
value.receipt: All five original cases land, plus round-2/3 guards: (F002) no authored string in the table may contain 'telemetry-nudge' — renderRecovery() is its only writer, so disposition and prose cannot disagree; (F001) the buffered outcome states the POSIX prerequisite in BOTH surfaces, covering the two Windows-reachable buffered modes; (F002 follow-on) the verified outcome uses 'not-applicable' and stays silent about the verb, because commit-service's verify-miss next_action names it and a blanket 'Do NOT' would contradict shipped code; (R2-F001) the page carries the prerequisite at least TWICE and the text after the rotate/replay sentence still names it, pinning 'the prerequisite travels with every standalone recovery instruction'. 34 passed (34).

value.title: Refresh this repo's own AGENTS.md block by running `harness instructions commit --inject` from the worktree, then verify by diff that nothing outside the managed markers moved. The repo that ships the guidance must not itself be carrying a stale copy.
value.receipt: 'harness instructions commit --inject' -> refreshed. 'git diff --numstat 5dae6e9c -- AGENTS.md' -> 6 added, 3 removed, ALL between the two markers (corrected from the wrong '11 lines' in round 1 — review F004).

value.title: Run `just checks` green, and confirm `harness doctor` from the worktree reports `commit-guidance: ok`. Record the Dim-0 evidence for ac-0002: adding a fifth `CommitMode` member must fail tsc AT THE GUIDANCE TABLE — if it only fails inside commit-service, the guarantee this plan exists to create does not hold.
value.receipt: just checks: every hard gate ok; the 3 warn-launch degradeds confirmed pre-existing — re-verified after the doc edits, 0 markdown findings for AGENTS.md and 0 for docs/how/gitai-collector.md. doctor: commit-guidance ok. Dim-0 re-run after the round-2 restructure: a fifth CommitMode member fails tsc with BOTH errors in commit-guidance.ts (:192 table, :207 renderer) while commit-service.ts compiles clean and keeps a zero-line diff vs base. Round 3 changed no behaviour the Dim-0 proof depends on. Transcripts in execution.log.md.
